name: delegate-claude-to-copilot
description: MCP bridge that lets Claude Code delegate coding tasks to GitHub Copilot CLI. Includes a /copilot skill and optional default-delegation policy.
author: MavromatisK

tools.name: delegate_to_copilot
tools.description: Delegate a coding task to GitHub Copilot CLI. Use this to outsource code generation, bug fixes, refactoring, shell commands, or any task where a second AI agent opinion is useful.

prompt.description: The task or question to send to Copilot

working_directory.description: Absolute path of the directory Copilot should work in. Defaults to the current working directory of the MCP server.
